market.summary: University library networks form the strongest repeated automation opportunity. National heritage services, the large Abrehot public library, NGO-supported children's libraries and Addis Ababa-based AU/UN research libraries have different access models. CEARL is the best evidenced academic coordination point; no functioning national union of physical holdings was verified. A feasibility sample of three successful public catalogs is not national LMS market share.
market.platform_strategy: Prioritize Koha adapter reuse and CEARL-led discovery of official public endpoints: live Admas proves one usable implementation; Hawassa and Arba Minch explicitly document Koha, with historical study evidence at AAU/Debre Berhan/Wolkite. Build separate custom parsers for accessible Abrehot Livewire and AU Drupal catalogs. NALA uses Soutron but its portal currently reports a licence error; UNECA links to Primo but policy prevents automated searches. Historical ABCD evidence must not be relabeled current Koha. No app integration performed.

limitations: No national largest-ten ranking established. Thirteen major priorities retain inaccessible libraries; sizes have different dates and units.
Only three substantial institutional catalogs produced actual book search responses; zero reserves; seven short of ten selected. No private-IP, authentication, challenge or TLS bypass used.
Proxy503/403 or timeout is an observation from this environment, not proof of a nationwide outage or absent holdings.
Public search does not establish visitor admission, borrowing rights, permission to reuse metadata, or live circulation.
Admas search succeeded despite homepage/detail timeouts; its size/source route is indexed official, not a currently retrievable library-page assertion.
Abrehot page labels Available and shelf numbers but no copy count or durable record URL verified. AU gives a physical-book call number but no circulation status.
Repositories, journals, ebooks and digitized manuscripts were not counted as successful physical-book catalogs; university branches were not counted again.
No live app adapter test, product configuration, outreach, account registration or deployment occurred.
